material.acceptance_criteria: duel-routes job prints 'moba match ok winner=<side> ticks=<n>' from the gate; the moba job asserts behaviours.osd win_on_base_loss has trigger="destroyed" action="declare_winner" tag="building" and prints 'moba win tag ok tag=building'.
material.description: The win trigger's base contract is on main: docs/SCENARIOS.md (21a577b0) states the win trigger identifies a side's base by filter tag, and scenarios/moba/behaviours.osd win_on_base_loss uses tag="building". The duel-routes job already prints the moba match line from the gate (rust/gate/src/mechanic_checks.rs:264, grep at .github/workflows/ci.yml gate step). The moba job separately asserts the win trigger reads the base tag; it does not duplicate the gate.
